# Third-party notices

<!-- generated by scripts/licenses/generate_notices.py - do not edit by hand; edit scripts/licenses/static.toml or allowed.toml and run it again -->

radarx-desktop is licensed under the [PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0](LICENSE). It builds on, bundles or loads at run time the third-party software, fonts, colour maps and map/terrain/imagery services listed below, each under its own terms. Those terms are not changed by the project licence.

**This is an engineering inventory, not legal advice.** Licence identifiers come from each package's own metadata (SPDX where given); entries that had none were identified by a script or by hand and are marked. The complete licence texts and copyright lines of the packages are in the packages themselves (the installers keep the `LICENSE`/`NOTICE` files that the packages ship; reproducing every text in this file is not done yet). **The wording and the completeness of this file are to be reviewed by a lawyer before wider redistribution.** How it is made and checked: [docs/LICENSES.md](docs/LICENSES.md).

## Needs attention

Components under a licence that is not simply permissive, and the non-commercial imagery. Each has a written reason in `scripts/licenses/allowed.toml` (or `static.toml`) for why it is accepted and how it is used. Anything here that changes with a release must be re-read.

Source: https://ffmpeg.org/ and https://github.com/PyAV-Org/pyav-ffmpeg; a notice with this text ships in the pack (licenses/av/FFMPEG-NOTICE.txt). |

## Native libraries bundled by Python wheels and the Python runtime

Wheels such as h5py, netCDF4, pyproj, Pillow, scipy and numpy ship shared libraries inside them, and PyInstaller copies them into the engine. Their licences come from the upstream projects and are **not** read from the built engine here; re-scan each release build with `python scripts/licenses/generate_notices.py --scan-engine python/dist/xradar-engine` (lists the shared libraries actually shipped) and compare.
